(def atom
  "Creates and returns an Atom with an initial value of x and zero or
  more options (in any order):

  :meta metadata-map

  :validator validate-fn

  If metadata-map is supplied, it will become the metadata on the
  atom. validate-fn must be nil or a side-effect-free fn of one
  argument, which will be passed the intended new state on any state
  change. If the new state is unacceptable, the validate-fn should
  return false or throw an Error.  If either of these error conditions
  occur, then the value of the atom will not change."
  (fn
    ([x] (Atom. x nil nil nil))
    ([x & options]
     (let [a (Atom. x nil nil nil)
           opts (apply hash-map options)
           metadata (get opts :meta)
           validator (get opts :validator)]
       (when metadata
         (if (map? metadata)
           (set! (.-meta a) metadata)
           (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Atom metadata must be a map"))))
       (when validator
         (set-validator! a validator))
       a))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation. Options follow Clojure's setup-reference: (apply hash-map options), so an odd option count throws "No value supplied for key"; a truthy :meta must be a map; a truthy :validator is installed with set-validator!, which validates the initial value (ClojureScript stores it without checking).
